speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long it has been present? Also, have you noticed any similar symptoms on your soles or elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you recall any specific exposures to animals or plants on the farm, and have you noticed any scaling or thickening of the skin on your palms? Also, has the rash spread to other parts of your body or changed in appearance over the year?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a pruritic rash, sensory loss on the palms, and classic skin changes like eyebrow thinning and hypopigmented macules strongly suggests Hansen's disease. To confirm the diagnosis, I need to check for the presence of acid-fast bacilli. REQUEST TEST: Slit Skin Smear

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal slit skin smear but strong clinical signs, I need to confirm the diagnosis histologically. REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results confirming chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy, combined with your clinical signs of sensory loss and hair loss, are diagnostic. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hansen's Disease (Leprosy)
